den.intro: A striped tent, its lamp lit though the sun is up. Inside, a thin man with three fingers on his right hand rattles bone dice in a leather cup.
den.offer: "Odo Three-Fingers, at your service," he says. "Fifty gold a throw. Low, you lose. Middling, I pay seventy-five. Three sixes, a hundred and fifty. Five throws, and then luck needs her rest."
den.count: Odo keeps the tally on his remaining fingers: you have thrown {count} times.
den.rolled: You lay {price} gold on the felt. The cup turns over.
den.lost: Low numbers. Odo sweeps the gold away so fast it seems never to have been yours.
den.won: A fair throw. Odo counts out 75 gold, slowly, as if each coin were a tooth.
den.jackpot: Three sixes. Odo looks at the dice, then at you, then pays 150 gold without a word.
den.spent: The cup is packed away. "Five throws, I said," Odo yawns. "Come back in another life."
den.rules_line1: "Three dice," Odo says, holding them up. "Half the time they fall low, and I keep your gold. One time in three they fall middling. One time in six, three sixes."
den.rules_line2: "You will say the house wins. The house says: the house has a tent to mend."
den.rules: Ask how the game is played
den.high: Sit at the high table ({price} gold, {uses_left} left)
den.high_roll1: The dice fall badly, and the high table is a hard teacher.
den.high_roll2: The dice fall well: 450 gold is pushed across the felt.
den.high_roll3: A strange throw. Odo pays 300 gold, and adds a red amulet from his own neck. "That one I lost fairly."
den.high_done: Odo draws a curtain aside. The table behind it is older than the tent. You lay down {price} gold.
